# Gold (XAU/USD) briefing — None SGT

Price is $3650.0, +114.2 (+3.23%) compared with yesterday's close of 3535.8.
Current read: BULLISH. Gold is being pushed UP right now. Because it's +3.23% compared with where it finished yesterday, and in the last hour it's been going up (+0.40%), and today's headlines lean good for gold (1 good vs 0 bad).
Today's range: low $3434.9 to high $3651.5. Price is 99% of the way up that range ($215.1 above the low, $1.5 below the high).
Trading sessions open right now: London. Next: US data drop (8:30am ET) in 78 minutes.
Measured from the last two days of 1-minute data, gold moves most in these hours (SGT): 02:00 (8.0 pips/min), 09:00 (7.7 pips/min), 22:00 (7.4 pips/min).
Related markets today: US dollar index 104.014 (+0.00%), US 10-year yield 4.936 (+1.82%), Silver 43.702 (+7.81%).
The US dollar is basically flat today, so it is not the thing pushing gold around right now.

Things that do not line up (these are usually the real story):
  - Gold and silver are diverging: silver +7.81% vs gold +3.23%. They normally move together, so this gap is unusual.
  - Bond yields moved +1.82% and gold moved +3.23%. Yields and gold normally move OPPOSITE ways, so this is backwards from the usual relationship.
  - Gold moved +3.23% while the dollar barely moved (+0.00%). So whatever moved gold today was not the dollar.
